posts.h1: Juvederm at NewDermaMed Toronto
posts.html:
Surgery is no longer the only way to make your face look younger. Juvederm and other treatments can help you look younger by enhancing your features, smoothing out fine lines, and adding volume to your face. All of this can be done in a short amount of time and with results that look natural.

At NewDermaMed Toronto, we use Juvederm injectable fillers to make you look fresh, balanced, and confident without changing who you are. This guide will help you understand what to expect from one of the most trusted brands of dermal fillers in the world, whether you’re looking into what Juvederm is or how long it lasts.

What Is Juvederm?

Juvederm is a dermal filler made with hyaluronic acid (HA) that adds volume, smooths out lines, and improves the shape of the face. Hyaluronic acid is a natural substance in your skin that keeps it hydrated, full, and flexible. As we get older, our HA levels drop, which can make our skin look less firm or defined over time.

That’s when Juvederm comes in. This injectable filler adds volume and moisture back to areas that have lost them while also bringing out your natural beauty. It doesn’t require surgery or a long recovery time.

Our medical injectors at NewDermaMed use Juvederm to give you smooth, natural-looking results that are perfect for your face shape and aesthetic goals. Every shot is done with care and skill to make sure that your look stays natural and expressive.

What Is Juvederm Made Of?

Hyaluronic acid is the main ingredient in Juvederm, which is what you need to know. This sugar molecule that is found in nature pulls in and holds onto water in the skin, giving it volume and moisture.

Different types of Juvederm are made for different things. Some are made to fill in lines, while others are made to add shape or fullness. They all have one thing in common: they all work well with your skin’s own tissue.

Juvederm also has lidocaine in it, which is a mild numbing agent that makes the treatment more comfortable. At NewDermaMed, we tailor each Juvederm treatment to meet your specific needs by using the right type and amount of filler. This level of accuracy makes sure that your results look balanced and not too full or fake.

Why Pick Juvederm?

There are many dermal fillers on the market today, but Juvederm is still one of the most trusted and cutting-edge. Health Canada has approved it, and skilled doctors worldwide have been using it for years.

People in Toronto love Juvederm because:

  • Results that happen right away and get better over time
  • The filler moves with your facial expressions, so it looks and feels natural
  • Hydration and rejuvenation that lasts a long time
  • A simple in-clinic treatment with little downtime
  • Safe and biocompatible formula that works for most skin types

Juvederm is a flexible and effective way to improve your lips, define your jawline, smooth out smile lines, or just make you look better overall.

Juvederm Is Often Used to Treat These Areas

Juvederm is versatile; it can improve the look of different areas of the face. Some common areas for treatment are:

  • Lips for a little extra volume and shape
  • Cheeks to add volume and lift, like when you were young
  • Jawline for better shape and definition
  • Smile lines (nasolabial folds) for a smoother look
  • Lines around the mouth that look like marionettes provide balance
  • Chin enhancement for a more defined profile
  • Hollows under the eyes to appear more awake and refreshed

At NewDermaMed Toronto, we always tailor our services to each client. Before making your Juvederm treatment plan, we look at the proportions of your face, how it moves, and what you want to look like.

The Juvederm Injectable Filler Process

The Juvederm injectable filler procedure is quick, accurate, and doesn’t require much cutting. It usually takes 30 to 45 minutes.

What to expect:

  • Consultation: We start with a one-on-one consultation to learn about your goals, the structure of your face, and your medical history. We’ll work together to pick the Juvederm product that works best for you.
  • Getting ready: The area to be treated is cleaned, and a topical numbing agent may be used to make it more comfortable. Most clients say that the Juvederm procedure is effortless to handle because it already has lidocaine in it.
  • Injection: Your injector carefully puts the filler into specific areas using small, precise needles or cannulas, shaping it and blending it perfectly with your natural contours.
  • Refinement: After the injections are done, your injector will carefully smooth and shape the area so that it looks even and natural.

You will see an immediate difference, and the full results will show up over the coming days as the filler settles.

How Long Does Juvederm Last?

People often ask us how long Juvederm lasts.

How long your results last depends on the product you use, the area being treated, and how fast your body burns calories. The effects of Juvederm usually last for 9 to 18 months. Some formulations, like those used for deeper contouring, like the jawline or cheeks, can last even longer.

As time goes on, your body naturally breaks down the hyaluronic acid in Juvederm and absorbs it safely. To keep their results steady and fresh, many clients choose to get maintenance treatments once or twice a year.

Your injector at NewDermaMed will help you figure out the best schedule to keep your desired look while keeping your results natural and subtle.

What Makes Juvederm Better Than Other Fillers?

There are many different kinds of dermal fillers, but Juvederm is the best because it has a smooth texture and lasts a long time.

Juvederm products use advanced Vycross™ technology to link hyaluronic acid molecules together better. This makes the filler blend in better with your skin and last longer than other types.

This makes Juvederm a great choice for anyone who wants a safe treatment, works as expected, and looks great.

Is Juvederm Safe?

Yes, for sure. Health Canada and the FDA both approve Juvederm. It is one of the most researched and trusted dermal fillers in the world. When done by trained professionals, like the medical staff at NewDermaMed Toronto, it is both safe and very effective.

Hyaluronic acid, a natural skin component, makes allergic reactions rare. Before we start treatment, our team will talk to you about everything to make sure you’re comfortable, safe, and a good fit for Juvederm.

What to Expect After Treatment

You can go back to most of your normal activities right away after getting Juvederm injectable filler. You might notice some mild swelling or pain, but this usually goes away in a day or two.

We suggest the following to help your skin settle nicely:

  • Not doing any intense exercise for 24 hours
  • Keeping treated areas clean and free of makeup for the first day
  • Avoiding very hot or very cold weather
  • Lying on your back to keep pressure off the area

Your injector will give you full post-op care instructions to ensure a smooth recovery.

The Results: Confident, Natural, and Subtle

At NewDermaMed, we believe that every improvement should look natural, balanced, and like you.

That’s precisely what Juvederm helps us do. The results are clear but not too much, giving you a fresh look that feels real and makes your beauty even better.

A lot of our clients say that the experience gives them more confidence, which is the kind of change that makes them look as lively and energetic as they feel.

Using Juvederm With Other Treatments

Juvederm can be used with other non-surgical treatments at NewDermaMed to make a more complete plan for rejuvenation. These include:

  • Botox to smooth out expression lines
  • Thread lifts for lifting and defining
  • Laser treatments to make skin feel better
  • Long-term skin health treatments that boost collagen

Our team will make a plan just for you to help you get the results you want in a safe and natural way.

We’re here to help if you’ve been considering getting a Juvederm treatment or just want to know more about how it can improve your natural beauty.

posts.title: How Do You Get Rid of Hyperpigmentation
posts.excerpt: You’re not alone if you’ve seen dark spots uneven patches or areas of discoloration that don’t seem to go away no matter what you do. At NewDermaMed hyperpigmentation is one of the most common skin problems we treat. It can happen to people of all ages genders and skin tones. It’s not just a cosmetic […]
posts.content_html_rest:
You’re not alone if you’ve seen dark spots uneven patches or areas of discoloration that don’t seem to go away no matter what you do. At NewDermaMed hyperpigmentation is one of the most common skin problems we treat. It can happen to people of all ages genders and skin tones. It’s not just a cosmetic problem it can change how you feel about your skin and your confidence.

The good news is you can treat hyperpigmentation. There are ways to even out your skin and bring back its natural glow no matter what caused it like sun damage acne scars hormonal changes or inflammation. In this guide we’ll talk about what hyperpigmentation is what causes it how to get rid of it with proven treatments like laser pigmentation treatment and how to keep your results for a long time.

What Is Hyperpigmentation?

Why Does It Happen?

Hyperpigmentation is when some parts of the skin look darker than the skin around them. This happens when your skin makes too much melanin which is the natural pigment that gives your hair skin and eyes their colour. When melanin builds up in certain areas it changes the colour of your skin. Depending on your skin tone the patches can be light brown to deep grey.

At NewDermaMed we usually see three main types of hyperpigmentation in our clients

  • Age spots or sun spots are caused by being in the sun for a long time. These are common on the hands chest shoulders and face
  • Post inflammatory hyperpigmentation PIH these spots appear after the skin has been hurt like by acne burns cuts or even harsh cosmetic procedures
  • Melasma is usually caused by hormones and shows up as symmetrical patches of brown or grey skin mostly on the cheeks forehead and upper lip

The Science Behind It

Melanocytes which are cells in the basal layer of the skin make melanin. When these cells are activated by sunlight hormones inflammation or injury they make more melanin to protect themselves. This is how your skin naturally reacts but sometimes it goes into overdrive and causes uneven pigmentation that doesn’t go away on its own.

We help clients at NewDermaMed understand that hyperpigmentation isn’t just a surface problem. Finding out what is causing the extra pigment and treating both the surface and deeper layers of the skin is the key to getting rid of it.

What Causes Hyperpigmentation?

Hyperpigmentation can be caused or made worse by a number of things inside and outside the body. Some of the most common are

  • UV radiation is the main thing that causes sun exposure. Being in the sun for just a few minutes without protection can make melanin which can make new spots or make old ones darker
  • Hormonal changes melasma is a common type of hormonal pigmentation that can happen during pregnancy while taking birth control pills or while getting hormone therapy
  • Dark marks may be left on the skin after it heals from acne wounds or irritation
  • Genetics some people are just more likely to get hyperpigmentation because of their genes
  • Skin damage if you exfoliate too much get laser burns or rub your skin too hard your body may respond by making more pigment
  • Some antibiotics anti seizure drugs and chemotherapy treatments can change the colour of your skin

It’s important to know what caused your pigmentation because each type needs a different treatment. This is where NewDermaMed’s professional evaluation makes all the difference.

How to Get Rid of Hyperpigmentation Quickly

Step 1: Start with Protection and Prevention

One thing must be clear before starting treatments no pigmentation treatment will work without protection from the sun. The sun is the biggest enemy of progress. Even small amounts of UV radiation every day can undo months of treatment.

To stop this from happening

  • Every morning even on cloudy days or when you’re inside use a broad spectrum sunscreen with an SPF of 30 or higher
  • If you’re outside put on sunscreen every two hours
  • During the hours when UV rays are strongest wear a hat with a wide brim and look for shade
  • Don’t use tanning beds at all

At NewDermaMed we want you to know that sunscreen is not just a product it’s your first line of defence against pigmentation.

Besides protecting your skin from the sun it’s also important to stick to a gentle regular skin care routine. Too much exfoliation scrubbing too hard or using strong actives without professional help can make inflammation worse and cause new dark spots.

Step 2: Use Topical Ingredients to Brighten and Treat

Topical treatments are very important for making the skin brighter and getting rid of hyperpigmentation. The results come slowly but they are an important step toward long term clarity.

Some of the best ingredients are

  • Vitamin C a strong antioxidant that protects against more pigmentation and makes skin look brighter
  • Niacinamide also known as vitamin B3 helps even out skin tone and makes the skin barrier stronger
  • Retinoids help cells turn over and fade skin colour over time
  • Azelaic acid works well for both acne and dark spots especially on sensitive skin
  • Kojic acid and arbutin are natural brightening agents that slowly fade dark spots
  • Tranexamic acid helps with hormonal pigmentation and melasma

We can suggest or prescribe medical grade products at NewDermaMed that are right for your skin type and condition. This makes sure that the results are safe and effective without causing irritation or rebound pigmentation.

Step 3: Get Professional Help for Deeper Pigmentation

Skincare and prevention can help keep your skin clear but deeper pigmentation usually needs professional help. The best choices are:

Peels with Chemicals

Chemical peels remove the top layers of skin and help new even toned skin grow. You can choose from different peel strengths based on your skin tone how sensitive it is and how deep the pigmentation is. If you have mild discoloration superficial peels are great. If you have more stubborn spots stronger peels can help.

Microdermabrasion

Microdermabrasion is a mechanical exfoliation method gets rid of the top layer of dead skin which makes it easier for brightening products to work. It’s gentle but works well on mild dullness and pigmentation on the surface.

Microneedling

Microneedling makes small controlled injuries to the skin that boost collagen production and speed up skin renewal. It also helps serums and lightening agents work better when applied afterward.

Treatment for Pigmentation with Lasers

Laser pigmentation treatment is often the best choice for pigmentation that is hard to get rid of or very deep. Lasers use focused light energy to break down extra pigment particles into smaller pieces that the body naturally gets rid of over time.

Our advanced laser systems at NewDermaMed are made to fit your skin type the depth of your pigmentation and the area you want to treat. We change the settings to make sure they are accurate and safe especially for people with darker skin tones who need special care.

Laser pigmentation treatments can effectively target

  • Age spots and sun spots
  • Freckles
  • Melasma with care and tailored protocols
  • Pigmentation after inflammation
  • Colour on the face neck chest and even hands

After just a few sessions most patients start to see visible improvement and the fading continues for several weeks.

Step 4: Use a Combination of Therapies for the Best Results

Combining different approaches often gives the best results. For example

  • A chemical peel followed by laser pigmentation treatment helps get rid of both surface and deep pigments
  • Microneedling with brightening serums makes the skin feel better and makes dark spots less noticeable
  • Topical treatments between procedures help keep progress and stop it from happening again

At NewDermaMed we look at your skin from many different angles to get natural even results that last.

How to Keep Results and Stop Them from Happening Again

You need to be patient and take care of hyperpigmentation. It’s important to protect your investment once your skin looks clearer.

Here are the most important things you need to do to be successful in the long run

  • Make sure to protect your skin from the sun every day. UV rays are the main cause of recurrence
  • Keep up with your skincare routine keep using ingredients that brighten and protect against free radicals
  • Don’t use harsh or untested products. Strong actives without professional supervision can cause new pigmentation
  • Keep inflammation in check to stop PIH post inflammatory hyperpigmentation treat acne eczema or irritation right away
  • Plan regular professional maintenance treatments light facials or gentle peels every few months can help keep your glow and pigmentation in check

Your skin’s needs may change over time and at NewDermaMed we change your maintenance plan to fit your changing goals and way of life.

Why You Should Choose NewDermaMed for Hyperpigmentation Treatment

When treating pigmentation it’s very important to pick the right clinic. Using lasers incorrectly or on the wrong skin can make discoloration worse instead of better.

We are proud of the following at NewDermaMed

  • Full skin evaluations before suggesting any treatment we figure out what kind of pigmentation you have what caused it and how deep it is
  • Advanced technology our clinic has the best laser and light tools made for all skin types
  • Personalized treatment plans each client’s plan is different and takes into account both safety and effectiveness
  • Experienced professionals our staff includes medical aestheticians and clinicians who have a lot of experience with managing pigment
  • Focus on education we show you how to take care of your skin at home to keep your results and protect them

We don’t just want to make dark spots go away for a short time we want to help you get a smooth even and glowing complexion that lasts.

FAQ About Hyperpigmentation

Can Hyperpigmentation Go Away by Itself?

With good sun protection mild cases may fade over time but deeper pigmentation usually needs professional treatment to see a big difference.

Is It Safe to Use Laser Treatment on Dark Skin?

Yes as long as the right laser and settings are used. We use cutting edge technology that has been adjusted for different skin tones at NewDermaMed to make sure it is safe and works.

How Many Times Will I Need to Get Treatment?

This depends on how bad your pigmentation is. After three to six sessions spaced out over a few weeks most patients see improvement.

Is It Possible to Get Rid of Melasma for Good?

You can control melasma but it may come back if your hormones change or you spend time in the sun. To keep it under control you need to take care of it and keep it up.

Will the Results Last Forever?

If you take the right steps to prevent it the results can last a long time after the pigment is gone. But if your skin isn’t protected from UV light or injury new pigmentation can form.

Conclusion

Hyperpigmentation can be hard to get rid of but it is possible. The key to success is a plan that is tailored to your needs and takes care of both the cause and the symptom whether they are melasma sun damage or post acne marks. We use science technology and personalized care at NewDermaMed to help you get skin that looks brighter smoother and more even toned.

It’s time to move on if you’re tired of hiding dark spots or feeling bad about having an uneven tone. Make an appointment at NewDermaMed today. We will look at your skin figure out what is causing your pigmentation and make a treatment plan just for you.

Let’s work together to get your skin back to being clear and confident. Glowing even skin is not only possible it’s within your reach.

Book your FREE Hyperpigmentation Treatment Consultation

Hyperpigmentation can be caused or made worse by a number of things inside and outside the body. Some of the most common are

  • UV radiation is the main thing that causes sun exposure. Being in the sun for just a few minutes without protection can make melanin which can make new spots or make old ones darker
  • Hormonal changes melasma is a common type of hormonal pigmentation that can happen during pregnancy while taking birth control pills or while getting hormone therapy
  • Dark marks may be left on the skin after it heals from acne wounds or irritation
  • Genetics some people are just more likely to get hyperpigmentation because of their genes
  • Skin damage if you exfoliate too much get laser burns or rub your skin too hard your body may respond by making more pigment
  • Some antibiotics anti seizure drugs and chemotherapy treatments can change the colour of your skin

It’s important to know what caused your pigmentation because each type needs a different treatment. This is where NewDermaMed’s professional evaluation makes all the difference.

How to Get Rid of Hyperpigmentation Quickly

Step 1: Start with Protection and Prevention

One thing must be clear before starting treatments no pigmentation treatment will work without protection from the sun. The sun is the biggest enemy of progress. Even small amounts of UV radiation every day can undo months of treatment.

To stop this from happening

  • Every morning even on cloudy days or when you’re inside use a broad spectrum sunscreen with an SPF of 30 or higher
  • If you’re outside put on sunscreen every two hours
  • During the hours when UV rays are strongest wear a hat with a wide brim and look for shade
  • Don’t use tanning beds at all

At NewDermaMed we want you to know that sunscreen is not just a product it’s your first line of defence against pigmentation.

Besides protecting your skin from the sun it’s also important to stick to a gentle regular skin care routine. Too much exfoliation scrubbing too hard or using strong actives without professional help can make inflammation worse and cause new dark spots.

Step 2: Use Topical Ingredients to Brighten and Treat

Topical treatments are very important for making the skin brighter and getting rid of hyperpigmentation. The results come slowly but they are an important step toward long term clarity.

Some of the best ingredients are

  • Vitamin C a strong antioxidant that protects against more pigmentation and makes skin look brighter
  • Niacinamide also known as vitamin B3 helps even out skin tone and makes the skin barrier stronger
  • Retinoids help cells turn over and fade skin colour over time
  • Azelaic acid works well for both acne and dark spots especially on sensitive skin
  • Kojic acid and arbutin are natural brightening agents that slowly fade dark spots
  • Tranexamic acid helps with hormonal pigmentation and melasma

We can suggest or prescribe medical grade products at NewDermaMed that are right for your skin type and condition. This makes sure that the results are safe and effective without causing irritation or rebound pigmentation.

Step 3: Get Professional Help for Deeper Pigmentation

Peels with Chemicals

Chemical peels remove the top layers of skin and help new even toned skin grow. You can choose from different peel strengths based on your skin tone how sensitive it is and how deep the pigmentation is. If you have mild discoloration superficial peels are great. Microneedling makes small controlled injuries to the skin that boost collagen production and speed up skin renewal. It also helps serums and lightening agents work better when applied afterward.

Laser pigmentation treatment is often the best choice for pigmentation that is hard to get rid of or very deep. Lasers use focused light energy to break down extra pigment particles into smaller pieces that the body naturally gets rid of over time.

  • Freckles
  • Melasma with care and tailored protocols
  • Pigmentation after inflammation
  • Colour on the face neck chest and even hands

  • A chemical peel followed by laser pigmentation treatment helps get rid of both surface and deep pigments
  • Microneedling with brightening serums makes the skin feel better and makes dark spots less noticeable
  • Topical treatments between procedures help keep progress and stop it from happening again

At NewDermaMed we look at your skin from many different angles to get natural even results that last.

You need to be patient and take care of hyperpigmentation. It’s important to protect your investment once your skin looks clearer.

  • Keep up with your skincare routine keep using ingredients that brighten and protect against free radicals
  • Don’t use harsh or untested products. Strong actives without professional supervision can cause new pigmentation
  • Keep inflammation in check to stop PIH post inflammatory hyperpigmentation treat acne eczema or irritation right away
  • Plan regular professional maintenance treatments light facials or gentle peels every few months can help keep your glow and pigmentation in check

Your skin’s needs may change over time and at NewDermaMed we change your maintenance plan to fit your changing goals and way of life.

When treating pigmentation it’s very important to pick the right clinic. Using lasers incorrectly or on the wrong skin can make discoloration worse instead of better.

  • Experienced professionals our staff includes medical aestheticians and clinicians who have a lot of experience with managing pigment
  • Focus on education we show you how to take care of your skin at home to keep your results and protect them

We don’t just want to make dark spots go away for a short time we want to help you get a smooth even and glowing complexion that lasts.

FAQ About Hyperpigmentation

Can Hyperpigmentation Go Away by Itself?

With good sun protection mild cases may fade over time but deeper pigmentation usually needs professional treatment to see a big difference.

Is It Safe to Use Laser Treatment on Dark Skin?

Yes as long as the right laser and settings are used. We use cutting edge technology that has been adjusted for different skin tones at NewDermaMed to make sure it is safe and works.

How Many Times Will I Need to Get Treatment?

This depends on how bad your pigmentation is. After three to six sessions spaced out over a few weeks most patients see improvement.

You can control melasma but it may come back if your hormones change or you spend time in the sun. To keep it under control you need to take care of it and keep it up.

Will the Results Last Forever?

If you take the right steps to prevent it the results can last a long time after the pigment is gone. But if your skin isn’t protected from UV light or injury new pigmentation can form.

Hyperpigmentation can be hard to get rid of but it is possible. The key to success is a plan that is tailored to your needs and takes care of both the cause and the symptom whether they are melasma sun damage or post acne marks. We use science technology and personalized care at NewDermaMed to help you get skin that looks brighter smoother and more even toned.

It’s time to move on if you’re tired of hiding dark spots or feeling bad about having an uneven tone. Make an appointment at NewDermaMed today. We will look at your skin figure out what is causing your pigmentation and make a treatment plan just for you.

Let’s work together to get your skin back to being clear and confident. Glowing even skin is not only possible it’s within your reach.

posts.excerpt: In the lively city of Toronto, where beauty and medical precision meet, a lot of people are getting advanced skincare treatments that give them amazing results with very little downtime. Chemical peels are one of the best ways to make your skin look younger and fresher. A chemical peel can help with sun damage, uneven […]
posts.content_html_rest:
In the lively city of Toronto, where beauty and medical precision meet, a lot of people are getting advanced skincare treatments that give them amazing results with very little downtime. Chemical peels are one of the best ways to make your skin look younger and fresher. A chemical peel can help with sun damage, uneven skin tone, big pores, or fine lines. We at NewDermamed think that treatments should be both effective and tailored to each person. Chemical peels are a big part of our approach. This blog post will tell you everything you need to know about getting a chemical peel in Toronto, including what it is, how it works, who it is for, what to expect, and how to find the best provider and peel depth for your needs.

What is a Chemical Peel?

The science behind it

A chemical peel is a cosmetic medical procedure that uses a carefully made solution to remove damaged outer layers of skin and exfoliate the skin. When used regularly, these treatments help new skin grow that is smoother, more even in colour, and stronger. Some of the benefits are smoother skin, smaller pores, fewer sun spots and fine lines, and clearer skin. It is much safer and more effective than over-the-counter peel products because a professional is in charge of and keeps an eye on the process. This is especially true in a city like Toronto, where clients expect and deserve high standards of care.

Why do so many people in Toronto get chemical peels

In a city where people are always busy and have a lot of work to do, chemical peels are clearly appealing:
• A lot of treatments can be done in less than an hour and don’t need much time to recover from
• They make the texture, tone, clarity, and radiance of the skin look better
• They act like a reset button for skin that has been exposed to stressors in the city, like sun, pollution, and dry indoor air
• They make skincare and professional treatments work better because the new skin is more responsive
We often suggest chemical peels as part of a plan to look younger at NewDermamed because they work and don’t take too long for professionals, parents, and people on the go.

Different kinds of chemical peels in Toronto

A light superficial peel

Works on the outer layer of skin (epidermis) and is best for mild discoloration, rough texture, and the first signs of aging. There is very little time off, and there may be some redness or peeling. Often used as a maintenance treatment or in a series to get a bigger effect.

Peel of medium thickness

Goes deeper into the mid-epidermis or upper dermis and works best on more severe sun damage, acne scars, or uneven skin tone. It takes a few days of peeling and being more sensitive to sunlight to get better. It is important to get follow-up care and protect yourself from the sun.

Deep peel

It goes deeper into the skin and is used for more serious signs of aging, deep scars, or big changes in skin colour. It takes a long time to recover, and peeling and downtime are necessary. Dermatologists should only do or watch deep peels because they are so strong. It’s important to know what depth of peel is best for you. At Newdermamed, we look at your skin, goals, and lifestyle before suggesting the best way to go.

What a chemical peel can help with

Problems with texture and fine lines

As we age and our skin is exposed to sun and environmental stress, texture becomes uneven. You might see tiny bumps, rough spots, big pores, and fine lines. A chemical peel helps by exfoliating dead surface cells and encouraging new collagen production for smoother, more elastic skin.

Problems with pigment

Sunspots, age spots, uneven tone, and hyperpigmentation are common in Toronto’s varied climate. The peel process removes damaged pigmented cells and promotes an even complexion.

Acne and acne scarring

For individuals with persistent acne or shallow acne scars, chemical peels can reduce oil-clogged pores, improve skin turnover, and gradually fade shallow scars and post-inflammatory pigmentation.

Post-treatment skincare absorption

After a peel, your skin is more receptive to serums, topical treatments, and professional products. Think of it as preparing the canvas so your skincare regimen can perform better.

The chemical peel process at NewDermamed

Step 1: Consultation and skin assessment

Your journey begins with a thorough consultation. At Newdermamed, our specialists review your medical history, skin type, prior treatments, desired outcome, and lifestyle. Together we decide which peel depth is appropriate and whether to combine it with other treatments such as microneedling, laser therapy, or topical products.

Step 2: Preparation

Before your peel, avoid excessive sun exposure, stop using harsh exfoliants or retinoids, and keep your skin hydrated. On the day of the treatment, your skin will be cleansed, and you’ll be reminded of aftercare guidelines.

Step 3: Treatment application

The peel is applied by a trained professional and involves:
• Cleansing and protecting sensitive areas (eyes and lips)
• Applying the chosen solution evenly
• Monitoring the skin until the peel is neutralized or complete
• Applying soothing serums or masks afterward
The entire process takes about 20–45 minutes depending on the area and peel depth.

Step 4: Recovery and aftercare

After treatment, your skin may feel slightly tight or tingly with some redness. Peeling or flaking typically begins within a few days. At Newdermamed, we provide a custom aftercare plan including gentle cleansing, moisturizing, and strict SPF use. Avoid picking or scrubbing and follow all care instructions for the best results.

Step 5: Follow-up and maintenance

Results begin to appear in the weeks after your peel as new skin emerges and collagen rebuilds. We often recommend a series of three to four peels spaced four to six weeks apart, followed by maintenance treatments every few months.

Who is a good candidate for a chemical peel in Toronto

Ideal candidate profile

You may be a good candidate if you:
• Have sun damage, age spots, uneven skin tone, large pores, or mild acne scarring
• Want skin rejuvenation without surgery or major downtime
• Have realistic expectations about results
• Can commit to proper aftercare and sun protection

When a peel may not be suitable

• If you have active skin infections or open wounds
• If you recently had sunburn or excessive tanning
• If you use certain medications that affect healing
• If you cannot follow post-care instructions
At Newdermamed, we ensure every client understands risks, benefits, and realistic outcomes before beginning treatment.

How to choose the best chemical peel provider in Toronto

Credentials and experience

When searching for “chemical peel near me” in Toronto, choose clinics that:
• Are operated by medically trained dermatologists or licensed aestheticians
• Use medical-grade solutions in a sterile environment
• Offer personalized consultations instead of one-size-fits-all services
• Provide transparent pricing and aftercare guidance

Depth and safety protocols

Ask about the peel depth, recovery time, and how your skin type may affect risk. A good provider will adjust the treatment to your specific skin tone and sensitivity.

After-care support

Reputable clinics provide ongoing care instructions and follow-up support. At Newdermamed, we prioritize client safety and monitor your recovery to ensure the best results.

Cost transparency

Chemical peel prices in Toronto vary based on peel strength and area treated. Superficial peels may start at a few hundred dollars, while deeper peels cost more. Clear discussion of pricing and results should always be part of your consultation.

What results can you expect and when

Timeline of visible change

• Days 1–3 Skin may feel tight, slightly red, or tingly
• Days 4–7 Peeling or flaking continues new skin begins to appear
• Weeks 2–4 Texture improves, and the skin looks smoother and brighter
• Months 1–3 Collagen remodelling continues, reducing fine lines and pigmentation

Chemical peels deliver significant improvement but are not a permanent fix. Ongoing skincare, sun protection, and maintenance peels are key for lasting results. At Newdermamed, we set achievable goals and design a long-term plan for your skin’s health.

Why chemical peels should be part of your rejuvenation plan at NewDermamed

At Newdermamed, we view chemical peels as more than a single treatment they are an essential part of ongoing skin health. Combined with medical-grade skincare, healthy lifestyle habits, and optional treatments like laser or microneedling, peels help reveal your skin’s natural radiance. Our Toronto-based team tailors each peel to your lifestyle, environment, and needs, ensuring results that look natural, healthy, and refreshed.

Conclusion

If you want smoother, clearer, and more radiant skin, a chemical peel treatment in Toronto is an excellent choice. With the right provider, personalized care, and consistent aftercare, the results can be transformative. At Newdermamed, we combine medical expertise with personalized attention to help you achieve glowing, youthful skin. Ready to take the next step? Book your consultation with NewDermamed today and discover how our chemical peel treatments can rejuvenate your skin and boost your confidence.

Book your FREE Chemical Peels Consultation

posts.content_html_rest:
It’s great to age gracefully, but occasionally small lines and wrinkles can make us look older or more fatigued than we are. Botox is what you need. You may look younger, more confident, and more naturally refreshed with this quick, safe, and effective treatment.

Our Uptown and Downtown Toronto clinics at NewDermaMed offer professional Botox treatments that are customized to your specific needs and goals. Our skilled dermatology experts can help you with “botox near me” to smooth out face wrinkles or “botox for migraines” to ease tension and pain.

What is Botox?

Botulinum Toxin Type A, or Botox, is a refined protein that temporarily relaxes some muscles under the skin. This relaxation makes expression lines less noticeable and stops new ones from growing, making your face look smoother and younger.

It’s one of the most popular non-surgical cosmetic procedures in the world, and for good reason: the results seem natural, happen quickly, and last a long time.

At NewDermaMed, only qualified dermatologists or medical injectors who are experts at making small, exact changes undertake Botox treatments. They never go too far.

What Toronto People Love About Botox

Life in Toronto may be hectic, and your skin often shows it. Wrinkles and fine lines can be caused by stress, being in the sun, and becoming older. Botox is a quick and easy approach to looking younger without having to take time off work or make big adjustments.

Why so many people choose Botox at NewDermaMed:

1. Fast treatments: It only takes 10 to 20 minutes for each session.

2. Immediate increase in confidence: Results start to show themselves in a few days.

3. Very little downtime: You can get back to work or social activities right away.

4. Effects that last: Your skin will feel smoother for up to four months.

5. Preventive benefits: Regular treatments help slow down the signs of aging.

Botox is often used in these areas

Botox works well on several parts of the face and neck, such as:

1. Lines on the forehead

2. Lines that frown (between the eyebrows)

3. Around the eyes, crow’s feet

4. Lines on the nose that look like bunnies

5. Dimpling on the jawline or chin

6. Neckbands

7. An eyebrow lift to make you seem younger

At NewDermaMed Toronto, we make sure that each treatment plan is tailored to your specific facial structure and cosmetic goals. The idea isn’t to make your face look stiff; it’s to bring out your inherent beauty in a way that is balanced and delicate.

Botox for Migraines: Not Just a Beauty Treatment

Did you know that Botox can also help with migraines?

Most people think of Botox as a cosmetic treatment, but it is actually an FDA-approved way to treat migraines that makes them less frequent and less severe. It stops pain signals from getting through and relaxes the muscles that can cause migraines.

Our medical staff at NewDermaMed has experience giving Botox for both cosmetic and medicinal reasons. We can help you figure out if this treatment is good for you if you get persistent migraines.

What does Botox do?

The science behind Botox is both interesting and easy to understand. Botox temporarily stops nerve signals that make certain face muscles contract when it is administered into those muscles. What happened? Skin that is smoother, has fewer wrinkles, and has a more relaxed, youthful look.

Repeated facial emotions, such as frowning, squinting, or smiling, can cause small lines to form over time. Botox makes these motions less frequent, which helps stop deeper wrinkles from appearing.

What to Expect When You Get Botox

Here’s what your visit to NewDermaMed in Uptown or Downtown Toronto for Botox will be like:

Consultation: A qualified injector or dermatologist looks over your goals, medical history, and the shape of your face.

Treatment plan: We list the locations that need to be treated and how much product you need.

Injection: Botox is injected into the right muscles with very thin needles.

Aftercare: You can get back to your normal activities right after, but we’ll give you some short aftercare recommendations.

The treatment is quick, safe, and almost painless. You don’t need any anesthesia or time off work.

How Long Will Botox Last?

Results usually show up in 3 to 7 days and last for 3 to 4 months. Your muscles get used to the treatments, and the results may last even longer over time.

We make sure that your look stays natural and balanced by scheduling follow-up visits at NewDermaMed. Our goal is to assist you in keeping your results all year long with no problems.

What You Should Know About Botox Side Effects

Botox is one of the most researched cosmetic procedures in the world, and it has a very good safety record. But like any other treatment, Botox can have adverse effects, most of which are small and go away on their own.

These can be:

A little redness or swelling at the site of the injection

A little bruising

A little pain or tightness that goes away on its own

These side effects normally go away in a day or two. Before, during, and after your treatment, our skilled injectors do everything they can to make sure you are comfortable and safe.

How Much Botox Costs in Toronto

The price of Botox depends on how many places need treatment and how much product is needed. We believe in clear, fair pricing at NewDermaMed, and we can make treatment programs that meet your budget.

Some common things that affect cost are:

How many units each person needs?

Size of the treatment region (for example, forehead vs. complete face)
We’ll give you a personalized price and talk about package possibilities during your appointment to help you save money on treatments in more than one area.

Find NewDermaMed in Toronto for Botox Near Me

NewDermaMed is the place to go if you want to find “botox near me” or “botox near me dermatologist.”

We happily serve clients from all over the GTA. We have two convenient sites in Toronto Uptown and Downtown each with modern facilities, courteous personnel, and medical-grade safety requirements.

Our skilled doctors and aesthetic specialists always give you natural, individualized results because you deserve to look your best without any compromises.

Why should you get Botox at NewDermaMed in Toronto?

Here’s what makes us different:

Certified Medical Experts: All Botox treatments are done by registered medical specialists. We utilize real Botox that has been approved by Health Canada, so you know you’re getting a high-quality product.
Natural Results: We think it’s better to enhance your traits than change them.
Two great locations: downtown and uptown Toronto, which are easy to get to.
Personalized Consultations: Plans that are made just for you based on your needs, lifestyle, and budget.
A Reputation You Can Trust: A lot of pleased customers and great feedback.

When you pick NewDermaMed, you’re picking professionals who care and get results that speak for themselves.

How to Take Care of Yourself After the Best Results

These simple aftercare tips can ensure your Botox treatment looks great:

Don’t rub or massage the region that was treated for 24 hours.

After getting injections, stay standing for 4 to 6 hours.

Don’t do any hard workouts for the rest of the day.

Don’t drink alcohol or spend too much time in the heat for 24 hours.

Use mild cleansers and moisturizers on your skin.

These steps will help your Botox last longer and look as natural as possible.

Start Your Journey to a New You

You should look as bright and sure of yourself as you feel. We can help you reach your objectives with safe, professional Botox treatments at NewDermaMed Toronto.

Our knowledgeable staff is here to help you with any questions you have regarding Botox, whether you’re looking for it nearby, want to know how much it costs, or are interested in using it for migraines.

Call us today to set up your free appointment at either our Uptown or Downtown Toronto clinic and find out why NewDermaMed is Toronto’s go-to name for Botox and advanced skin care.

posts.content_html_rest:
One of the most common questions we get from clients at NewDermaMed is what is Botox and how does it work.

When people hear the word Botox they often think of skin that is smoother and has fewer wrinkles. But this treatment is more than just skin deep. It is one of the most researched and flexible medical aesthetic procedures in the world and it can help with both health and beauty.

This complete guide will help you understand everything you need to know about Botox for wrinkles Botox for migraines or just what happens during and after the treatment. This way you can make smart confident decisions about your care.

What is Botox?

Botulinum toxin type A a purified protein from the bacterium Clostridium botulinum is sold under the name Botox. That might sound scary but it has been safely used in both cosmetic and therapeutic medicine for decades in carefully controlled medical grade doses.

Botox is injected into specific facial muscles to make wrinkles and fine lines less noticeable. It is also approved by doctors to treat chronic migraines hyperhidrosis too much sweating and muscle spasms.

At NewDermaMed we use cutting edge injection methods to give you results that look natural so you never look frozen or overdone.

How Botox Works?

It’s helpful to know a little about how your nerves and muscles talk to each other to understand how Botox works. When you frown squint or smile your nerves send a signal to your muscles to contract. These contractions happen over and over again which causes dynamic wrinkles to form. You can see these wrinkles between your brows around your eyes or across your forehead.

Botox temporarily stops this communication by stopping the release of acetylcholine which is the neurotransmitter that makes muscles contract. When the muscle relaxes the skin on top of it smooths out which makes lines less noticeable and stops new ones from forming.

The effects are short lived precise and limited to one area. Usually the results show up in three to seven days peak around two weeks and last for three to six months before slowly fading away.

Why People Get Botox?

To Look Better

Most people use Botox to treat

  • Lines on the forehead and horizontal creases
  • Lines that form between the eyebrows when you frown the 11 lines
  • Wrinkles around the eyes that look like crow’s feet
  • Bunny lines on the nose
  • Orange peel texture or dimpling on the chin
  • Bands around the neck platysmal bands

Botox helps you look younger and smoother by relaxing the tiny muscles in your face that cause these wrinkles. You don’t need surgery or time off work. Our goal at NewDermaMed is to strike a balance between refreshing your look and keeping your natural expression.

For Health Benefits

Botox is not only for beauty it also has strong medical uses.

Botox for Headaches

People who have chronic migraines can feel better after getting Botox injections. Botox can help reduce muscle tension and nerve overactivity when injected into specific areas of the forehead temples and neck. This can make migraines happen less often and less severely.

Botox for Hyperhidrosis Too Much Sweating

Botox can stop sweating in the underarms palms or feet for several months by blocking the nerve signals that make sweat glands work.

Other Uses in Medicine

Botox is used all over the world to treat eye spasms jaw tension TMJ disorders and some muscle stiffness conditions in addition to its cosmetic and migraine relieving effects. At NewDermaMed we customize each treatment to meet your specific medical or beauty needs.

How Botox Works Getting Ready and Talking to Your Doctor

A personalized consultation is the first step in every Botox journey at NewDermaMed. We check the following during this appointment

  • Your skin type how much you work out and what areas you are worried about
  • Your medical history including any medications or health problems you have
  • Your aesthetic goals and how much correction you want

Next we make a personalized treatment plan that focuses on balance accuracy and natural movement. You’ll know exactly what to expect how many units you’ll need and what results you can realistically expect.

The Process of Giving an Injection

The actual procedure is quick and easy usually taking 10 to 30 minutes depending on how many areas are treated. This is what happens

  • The area has been cleaned and set up
  • Ultra fine needles are used to make small precise injections into the target muscles
  • You may feel a light pinch or pressure but discomfort is minimal and numbing cream can be applied if needed

Botox is a real lunchtime procedure because you can go back to most normal activities right after treatment.

When You Will Start to See Results

Most clients see results within 3 to 5 days and by 2 weeks they can see a big difference. Many clients say their skin looks smoother and more relaxed and some say it looks lifted.

Results typically last three to six months depending on factors like your metabolism lifestyle and muscle activity. Regular treatments can even teach the muscles to contract less strongly which makes the effects last longer.

Aftercare for Botox

Proper aftercare is key to achieving the best longest lasting results. At NewDermaMed we provide each client with simple science backed post treatment guidance.

Immediate Care First 24 Hours

  • Avoid lying down for at least four hours after treatment
  • Refrain from rubbing or massaging the injection area
  • Skip vigorous exercise hot yoga saunas and steam rooms for 24 hours
  • Do not apply makeup or harsh skincare products right away

Short Term Care First Few Days

  • If you notice mild redness tenderness or small bumps they should fade within a few hours to a day
  • Avoid alcohol and blood thinning medications unless prescribed to reduce bruising risk
  • Be patient results take time the product gradually binds to the nerve endings for full effect

Long Term Maintenance

  • Schedule touch ups every 3 to 6 months to maintain consistent results
  • Use sunscreen daily UV exposure accelerates skin aging and may counteract your Botox results
  • Keep your skin hydrated with a good moisturizer and follow a medical grade skincare routine

Our team at NewDermaMed monitors your progress and helps plan future appointments to maintain your refreshed appearance naturally and comfortably.

Safety and Side Effects

When performed by trained professionals Botox is extremely safe. However as with any medical procedure minor side effects may occur.

Possible short term reactions include

  • Mild swelling bruising or redness at the injection site
  • Temporary headache or tight sensation
  • Minor asymmetry that usually resolves as the product settles

Serious complications are rare but can include drooping eyelids or muscle weakness if the product spreads outside the intended area which is why choosing an experienced injector is crucial.

At NewDermaMed all injections are performed by licensed medical professionals with extensive anatomical knowledge and a track record of safety. We use only authentic Health Canada approved Botox products and adhere to the highest clinical standards.

Why Choose NewDermaMed for Botox

Choosing where to get Botox is just as important as choosing to get it. At NewDermaMed we combine medical expertise with artistry to deliver results that feel natural balanced and truly personalized.

Here’s what sets us apart

  • Comprehensive consultations we take time to understand your goals and design a treatment that enhances your features not changes them
  • Medical expertise our team includes licensed practitioners with years of experience performing safe precise injections
  • Advanced techniques we stay updated with the latest advancements to ensure every treatment is efficient and comfortable
  • Safety first your well being is our priority every product is sourced from verified medical suppliers
  • Natural results our approach focuses on soft rejuvenation so you still look like you just more refreshed

Whether your goal is to soften wrinkles relieve migraines or prevent new lines from forming NewDermaMed ensures that your Botox experience is seamless effective and empowering.

Frequently Asked Questions About Botox

Will I Look Frozen After Botox?

Not at all. When performed correctly Botox softens lines without affecting your natural expressions. You’ll still smile frown and laugh just without the creases.

How Long Does Botox Last?

Results generally last three to six months. Regular maintenance can extend the benefits and even reduce how often you need touch ups over time.

Can Botox Prevent Wrinkles?

Yes. Botox can be used preventively to stop fine lines from becoming deeper wrinkles especially in people who start treatments in their late twenties or thirties.

Is Botox Painful?

Most clients describe the sensation as a quick pinch. The needles are very fine and any discomfort is temporary.

Is Botox Only for Women?

Absolutely not. Botox is increasingly popular among men who want to look rested and confident without surgery.

What’s the Difference Between Botox and Fillers?

Botox relaxes muscles to smooth wrinkles caused by movement while dermal fillers restore lost volume or contour. The two are often combined for full facial rejuvenation.

The Long Term Benefits of Botox?

With consistent care Botox not only treats existing lines but also helps prevent future ones. It’s part of a modern proactive approach to skincare and aging gracefully. Many clients at NewDermaMed notice that over time their skin looks smoother even between treatments as repeated relaxation of facial muscles prevents new wrinkles from forming.

Beyond aesthetics clients using Botox for migraine or other medical conditions often report a noticeable improvement in their quality of life fewer headache days better comfort and improved confidence.

Conclusion

Botox isn’t just about beauty it’s about confidence comfort and control. Whether you’re smoothing fine lines easing chronic migraines or simply refreshing your look this treatment offers a proven safe and transformative solution when performed by experts.

At NewDermaMed our mission is to help you look and feel your best with precision care advanced technology and results you’ll love seeing in the mirror.

If you’re curious about Botox ready to treat wrinkles or want to explore Botox for migraines now is the perfect time to take the next step. Book your personalized consultation with NewDermaMed today. Our team will analyze your skin discuss your goals and design a treatment plan tailored just for you. Discover what’s possible when medical expertise meets aesthetic artistry and let your confidence shine from the inside out.

Many people want to change their look in a way that doesn’t feel too drastic. That is easier to do than ever thanks to today’s advanced cosmetic technology. For people who want a subtle, graceful way to look younger without surgery or downtime, the thread lift has become one of the most popular non-surgical facelift options.

We at NewDermaMed Toronto are proud to offer the Aptos Excellence Visage thread lift, a sophisticated treatment that will improve the shape of your face, make it firmer, and boost your confidence—all while keeping your expressions looking natural.

This guide will tell you everything you need to know before you book your consultation, whether you’re looking for a thread lift near me or just want to learn more about how the procedure works.

What is Thread Lift?

Using fine, dissolvable threads placed just under the skin, a thread lift is a gentle, minimally invasive procedure that helps reshape and lift the contours of the face.

A thread lift works from the inside out, supporting your skin’s natural structure and encouraging the production of new collagen and elastin. This is different from a traditional facelift, which requires cuts and a long recovery time.

We use the Aptos Excellence Visage threads at NewDermaMed. These are the best in the business and were made by experts in aesthetic medicine from around the world. These threads lift your skin right away and keep it looking younger as your skin grows back around them.

Why should you choose Aptos Excellence Visage Threads?

The Aptos Excellence Visage system is one of the most advanced thread technologies on the market right now. These threads are made of high-quality, biocompatible materials like polylactic acid (PLA) and polycaprolactone (PCL). These materials are known for promoting long-term collagen production and giving the skin structure.

Aptos Excellence Visage is different because it is very precise. Each thread has tiny filaments that go in all directions and hold the tissue in place without hurting it. This technique makes sure that the result is even, balanced, and fresh-looking, never tight or overdone.

The result is a naturally lifted, polished look that gets better over the course of several months as your skin makes more collagen.

Clients at NewDermaMed Toronto love Aptos Excellence Visage because it works well, doesn’t take long to heal, and leaves a beautiful, natural finish.

How the Thread Lift Works

At NewDermaMed, skilled professionals do the thread lift procedure, which is comfortable and works well. Here’s a step-by-step guide to how it works:

Personal Consultation: We start with a thorough consultation to learn about your goals, look at the shape of your face, and come up with a treatment plan that is unique to you.

Preparation: A topical numbing cream or local anaesthetic is used to make sure the person is completely comfortable. The skin is cleaned, and exact marks show where to put the threads.

Thread Placement: The Aptos Excellence Visage threads are carefully put under the skin along natural lifting vectors using a fine, flexible cannula. This instantly smooths out the edges and gives light support.

Collagen Activation: Your body makes new collagen around the threads over time, which makes them firmer, more toned, and more elastic.

The whole process usually takes 30 to 60 minutes, and you can go back to most of your normal activities right after.

What Should You Expect?

Most clients see an immediate difference after their thread lift, and the results keep getting better over the coming months. The Aptos Excellence Visage threads give your skin a smooth, lifted look that makes it look fresh instead of “done.”

During your consultation, our experts can show you pictures of thread lift procedures that show what this advanced technique can do. Each result is tailored to bring out your best features while keeping your face moving naturally.

Thread lift has many benefits

The thread lift is one of the most popular non-surgical facelift treatments in Toronto for several reasons. Customers love it because it’s fast, works, and boosts confidence in a small way.

Some of the main benefits are:

1. Quick improvement with little downtime

2. Results that look natural and keep facial expression

3. Long-term skin rejuvenation through collagen stimulation

4. No cuts, scars, or general anesthesia

5. Less expensive and easier than regular surgery

6. Slow, elegant improvement over the course of several months

At NewDermaMed, we use both advanced thread techniques and expert artistry to make sure that every result looks soft, balanced, and like you.

Thread Lift vs. Face Lift Surgery

Both thread lifts and face lifts aim to enhance the facial shape, albeit through distinct methods. A surgical facelift requires cuts and a longer recovery time, but a thread lift is a good non-surgical option.

The thread lift is perfect for people who want to look younger and have tighter skin without having to have surgery, take time off work, or get scars. People often call it a “nonsurgical facelift” because it makes you look younger and more refreshed without surgery.

Cost of Thread Lift in Toronto

The price of a thread lift depends on how many threads are used, where the treatment is done, and how complicated your personalized plan is.

After your consultation at NewDermaMed Toronto, we will give you clear, personalized prices. Thread lifts, especially with Aptos Excellence Visage threads, are a cost-effective way to get long-lasting facial rejuvenation, even though prices vary.

We also have combination treatment plans and flexible options to make your trip as easy as possible.

Areas That Are Often Treated

The thread lift can improve many parts of the face and neck, such as:

For a lifted contour, the treatment targets the cheeks and the middle of the face.

Jawline for a more pronounced look

Brow area to make your eyes look more open

Neck and lower face for a more refined texture and tone

Because Aptos Excellence Visage threads can be used in so many ways, our practitioners can customize the treatment to meet your specific needs and give you natural, beautiful results.

Who Would Be a Good Fit?

A thread lift is a viable option for people who want to make their face firmer and more defined without having surgery. For those who wish to help collagen regenerate over time and maintain the natural contours of their face, this is a fantastic option.

When you come in for a consultation at NewDermaMed, our experts will look at your skin and suggest the best treatment for you, whether that means a thread lift on its own or a combination of non-surgical facelift treatments.

Aftercare and Recovery

It’s easy and quick to recover from a thread lift. Most people are back to their normal routines within a day or two.

To get the best results, follow these aftercare tips:

Don’t do any hard exercise for about five days.

For the first week, sleep on your back.

Don’t receive facial massages or do heavy skin care for a few days.

Drink enough water and keep your skin safe from the sun.

It’s normal for your skin to feel a little sensitive or tight for a short time. It will go away on its own as your skin gets used to it.

How long do the results last?

You’ll notice a difference right away, and the full results will come in over the coming months as collagen builds up.

The Aptos Excellence Visage threads are known for how long they last. Depending on your skin type and lifestyle, the results usually last between 12 and 24 months. To keep their new look going, many clients schedule maintenance sessions every year or two.

The Non-Surgical Facelift Is Getting More Popular in Toronto

More and more people in Toronto and across Canada are choosing nonsurgical facelift treatments instead of traditional surgery. The thread lift is now one of the most popular options because it works and doesn’t require any downtime, risk, or a “pulled” look.

At NewDermaMed, we use advanced Aptos Excellence Visage thread lifts along with other medical aesthetic treatments, like dermal fillers or skin rejuvenation procedures, when they are appropriate, to give you a full, personalized transformation.

Our team has the right mix of medical knowledge and artistic skill if you want a non-surgical facelift in Toronto.

Why You Should Get Your Thread Lift at NewDermaMed Toronto

When you look for “thread lift near me,” you want a clinic that has a lot of experience, is safe, and knows how to enhance your natural beauty. That’s precisely what you’ll get at NewDermaMed Toronto.

This is why people trust our clinic:

The procedures are performed by skilled medical professionals who are trained in the use of Aptos Excellence Visage methods.

We use threads and technology that have been approved by Health Canada.

Individualized consultations and treatment plans that are simple to understand

Locations in both Uptown and Downtown Toronto that are simple to get to

A supportive, comfortable place that helps you reach your goals

A history of happy clients and beautiful, real results

Every treatment at NewDermaMed is meant to make you look fresh, confident, and comfortable in your skin.

The Strength of Collagen Renewal

Collagen stimulation is one of the best things about a thread lift, in addition to the visible lift. Collagen is the protein that makes skin strong, smooth, and flexible. As we get older, our bodies naturally slow down production, but the threads help your body start this important process again.

This means that over time, your skin will feel stronger, more flexible, and radiant—an improvement that comes from the inside out.

Set up your thread lift consultation for today

The Aptos Excellence Visage thread lift at NewDermaMed Toronto might be the perfect option for you if you want to improve your natural beauty without having surgery.

From the first consultation to the last bit of care, our team of experts will be there to help you every step of the way, making sure you have a good time and get great results.

Call us today to set up your free consultation at our Uptown or Downtown Toronto clinic and learn how a thread lift can make you feel fresh, confident, and naturally lifted.

posts.title: How to Prepare for Sclerotherapy – Before and After Care
posts.excerpt: At NewDermaMed, we have helped countless patients regain their confidence, enhance their natural beauty, and feel better about their appearance through the removal of varicose veins and spider veins. Though there are a variety of methods available for varicose vein removal one of the most popular options which provides lasting results is sclerotherapy.
posts.content_html_rest:
At NewDermaMed, we have helped countless patients regain their confidence, enhance their natural beauty, and feel better about their appearance through the removal of varicose veins and spider veins. Though there are a variety of methods available for varicose vein removal one of the most popular options which provides lasting results is sclerotherapy.

When considering sclerotherapy our patients often have questions about how they will need to prepare for their procedure as well what they will need to do for after care. We are always here to support you in feeling fully prepared and confident about your procedure. In this article, we outline what you need to know about preparing for sclerotherapy and what you should know about after care.

Always consult with your care provider for directions based on your unique circumstances. For more information about varicose and spider vein removal see our previous article, How to Get Rid of Spider Veins and Varicose Veins.

What Is Sclerotherapy?

Sclerotherapy is a non-invasive procedure that involves injecting a solution directly into the vein, causing the vein to scar, collapse, and eventually fade away. This procedure requires little to no downtime and is virtually painless making it an ideal treatment for many patients. Results of sclerotherapy are final as once treated the malfunctioning vein is destroyed.

What Should I Do Before My Procedure?

Before your procedure you can expect to have a detailed consultation with your service provider. You may need an ultrasound of the affected area to effectively plan how your procedure will take place. On the day of and days before your procedure be sure to follow the directions provided by your care provider which may include the following directions for how to prepare for sclerotherapy.

  • Avoid smoking and alcohol for 48 hours before your procedure
  • Do not take anti-inflammatory medication
  • Do not shave or apply lotions
  • Wear loose fitting clothing
  • Eat as your regularly would
  • Bring compression stockings if you have them

When Will I See Results from Sclerotherapy?

Our clients always want to know and ask us, how long after sclerotherapy to see results? This will depend on the severity of your veins and your expectation of results should be discussed with your care provider before your procedure. For smaller varicose veins you will typically see results in as little as three to six weeks. Larger more complex varicose veins may take more than three months and possibly multiple treatments before desired results are achieved.

Are Compression Stockings Necessary After Sclerotherapy?

Compression stockings are an important component of your self-care and post-procedure care. We will ensure you are properly fitted for compression stocking during your consultation. Most care providers will request you wear compression stockings for a period of time after your procedure often for a minimum of two weeks. You will not likely need to restrict your activity after your procedure though in addition to wearing compression stockings you may be asked to limit sun exposure shortly after your treatment.

posts.excerpt: Compression stockings sometimes referred to as flight socks, are often recommended to be worn for anyone who spends a long amount of time on their feet or for those who suffer from varicose veins and spider veins. Though you might have been asked to wear them, you might be wondering what they can do to […]
posts.content_html_rest:
Compression stockings sometimes referred to as flight socks, are often recommended to be worn for anyone who spends a long amount of time on their feet or for those who suffer from varicose veins and spider veins. Though you might have been asked to wear them, you might be wondering what they can do to help you and if they are truly worth the struggle of getting them on.

At NewDermaMed, we suggest compression stockings for many of our patients who are looking to treat varicose veins and spider veins both before and after they complete treatments. We know that compression stockings can be a key component in preventing damage to veins that causes varicose veins and spider veins. We are here to answer your questions about compression stockings as you consider varicose vein treatments such as sclerotherapy or laser vein removal.

How Do Compression Socks Work?

Compression stockings are specially designed to support healthy blood circulation by reducing the diameter of distended veins and increasing venous blood flow velocity and valve effectiveness. Compression stockings feel very snug and gently add compression to your veins promoting better circulation. In order to work, your compression stockings must provide adequate pressure.

Do I Need to Be Fitted for Compression Stockings?

It may be tempting to pick up compression stockings online or at a department store though for best results you will want to be fitted professionally. By choosing a professional such as your vein treatment provider or a pharmacy staff member to fit you for your compression stockings you ensure you are getting the full benefit of your socks. Compression stockings that do not fit well may not be worth wearing at all.

Will Compression Socks Help with Spider Veins?

Compression stockings will not remove spider veins or varicose veins, but they can help to prevent the worsening or new development of these vein issues. It is important to note that there are many factors that can affect the development of varicose veins including your genetics. Our previous article How to Get Rid of Spider Veins and Varicose Veins can assist you in understanding how to remove your varicose veins. It may be a good idea for you to wear compression stockings even if you have no intention to remove your varicose and spider veins, consider speaking with a medical doctor for advice based on your unique circumstances.

How to Wear Compression Stockings for Varicose Veins

Wearing compression stockings can help with the prevention of varicose veins and are necessary after a vein removal procedure. You should wear your compression stockings throughout the day but it is not necessary to wear them while sleeping. Make a habit out of putting your compression stockings on first thing in the morning and be sure to take them off before bed. Compression stockings fit tightly and it may be helpful to have a professional show you how to easily put them on and take them off to reduce any frustration you may have with wearing them.

At NewDermaMed, we are always here to answer your questions and provide support with the removal of varicose veins. Contact a member of our team today to learn how you can regain your confidence through treating your varicose and spider veins.

posts.title: Do Varicose Veins Hurt?
posts.excerpt: If you have noticed the appearance of varicose veins on yourself or someone you love, you may be wondering, can varicose veins cause leg pain? Varicose veins are often highly visible and depending on the severity of the issues, can cause some leg pain and discomfort.
posts.content_html_rest:
If you have noticed the appearance of varicose veins on yourself or someone you love, you may be wondering, can varicose veins cause leg pain? Varicose veins are often highly visible and depending on the severity of the issues, can cause some leg pain and discomfort.

Some people develop varicose veins in pregnancy while others are genetically predisposed to their development. Regardless of how they formed, varicose veins can be troublesome and contribute to a lack of confidence in appearance along with pain and discomfort. At NewDermaMed we want you to feel just as good about yourself on the outside as you do on the inside. In this article, we outline what you should know about varicose vein pain.

For more information on varicose veins see our previous article, Are Varicose Veins Dangerous and Pregnancy and Varicose Veins.

Why Do Varicose Veins Hurt at Night?

Your varicose veins may hurt at night or at the end of the day as they are inflamed from the pressure put on them throughout the day. It is not uncommon to feel pain or pressure in the legs after a busy day on your feet when you have varicose veins. If your varicose veins regularly cause you pain at night it would be a good idea to consult with your doctor on treatment.

Do Varicose Veins Hurt When Touched?

In most cases, varicose veins do not hurt when touched. Some people may find the area around their varicose veins can become tender when touched if the veins are inflamed. Overall, many people go throughout their day without noticing that their varicose veins are there. It is not uncommon for people to only think of their varicose veins when looking in a mirror or when feeling discomfort after a busy or long day on their feet.

Do Varicose Veins Hurt When Walking?

Varicose veins can become inflamed when excess pressure is put on them. Walking for long amounts of time or running can increase the likelihood that a person’s varicose veins will cause pain. Thankfully there are a few things you can do to reduce the likelihood you will experience pain and allow you to keep doing the exercise and activities that bring you joy.

How to Stop Varicose Vein Pain

For many people, varicose veins can be managed by wearing compression stockings and keeping off their feet when experiencing a flare-up. Some people find that elevating their feet and taking an anti-inflammatory medication such as Ibuprofen can be helpful.

For others, removal of the varicose veins can be an ideal option. Though varicose veins are often a cosmetic issue, they can become troubling for some people and varicose vein removal may be the best option. There are a few options to choose from when it comes to removing varicose veins and the one you choose will be dependent on the severity of your varicose veins. To see if you are a good candidate for laser vein removal, contact the professionals at NewDermaMed. We look forward to helping you look and feel your best.
