team.heading: NewDermaMed Team
team.text: NewDermaMed Team Scroll down to view our full team of highly trained and experienced cosmetic surgeons and medical professionals. Dr. Negin Mastouri Medical Director/ Aesthetic Doctor See More Dr. Luis Figueroa Vascular Surgeon See More Alin Gharibian Clinic Director/Cosmetic Consultant See More Dr. Negin Mastouri Medical Director/ Aesthetic Doctor Dr. Negin Mastouri is an accomplished Medical Director and Aesthetic Doctor with a passion for helping her clients achieve their best selves. She is a graduate of the prestigious University of Toronto and is board-certified in Family Medicine with a clinical fellowship in Hospital Medicine. Dr. Mastouri is also an international board-certified specialist in Infectious Disease, with a particular focus on infection prevention and control. With a special interest in skin disorders, aesthetic medicine, and women’s health, Dr. Mastouri is dedicated to providing personalized, preventive, and predictive healthcare to her clients. She is a Fellow in Metabolic and Nutritional Medicine (FMNM) and a proud member of the American Academy of Anti-Aging Medicine. What sets Dr. Mastouri apart is her holistic, wellness-oriented approach to patient care. She uses the latest scientific breakthroughs and takes an interdisciplinary approach to help her clients achieve optimal health and well-being. Dr. Mastouri is also an Assistant Professor at McMaster University, where she shares her knowledge and expertise with the next generation of medical professionals. Whether you’re looking for a specific treatment or want to take a more comprehensive approach to your health, Dr. Mastouri is here to help. Dr. Mastouri’s expertise in advanced facial rejuvenation and Botox techniques enables her to offer personalized cosmetic treatments that enhance natural beauty and create a refreshed appearance. Using advanced dermal fillers, injectables, and laser therapies, she addresses a range of cosmetic concerns while also providing specialized treatments for skin issues like acne and hyperpigmentation. With a focus on safety and effectiveness, Dr. Mastouri works closely with each client to develop a personalized treatment plan that aligns with their goals and needs. Her passion for aesthetic medicine drives her to stay up-to-date with the latest advancements in cosmetic treatments and techniques. Dr. Luis Figueroa Vascular Surgeon Dr. Figueroa is a practicing vascular surgeon and a fellow at The Royal College of Surgeons of Canada. He graduated from The University of Toronto, Vascular Surgery Program, and thereafter joined the division as a lecturer. Dr. Figueroa has practiced vascular surgery at Toronto’s Humber River Hospital and North Toronto Vascular Surgery. Alin Gharibian Clinic Director/Cosmetic Consultant Certified in Cosmetic Dermatology & Medical AestheticsWith a Bachelor of Science in Biology and advanced certifications in Cosmetic Dermatology and Medical Aesthetics, Alin Gharibian is a skilled expert in anti-aging and skin rejuvenation treatments. Specialized training in anti-aging therapies ensures the delivery of innovative, evidence-based solutions tailored to meet each client’s unique needs. As the Director of NewDermaMed, Alin leads with a dedication to excellence, blending scientific knowledge with a personalized touch. This commitment has established NewDermaMed as a trusted destination for achieving natural, youthful results through advanced cosmetic treatments. Driven by a passion for enhancing confidence and well-being, Alin remains at the forefront of the medical aesthetics industry. By combining cutting-edge science with artistry and compassion, every treatment is designed to empower and inspire confidence in clients. Abbas Ashrafsadeh IMG, Aesthetic Physician (UAE) Abbas Ashrafzadeh, a Dubai-based aesthetic physician with 20+ years of experience, has treated over 1000+ Aptos Thread Lift procedures including celebrities seeking subtle, flawless cosmetic enhancements.
